Aggressive ya Passive: tum kaunse trader ho? ⚡

Aggressive trader jaldi me hai, market order se abhi sauda chahta hai, aur spread ki keemat deta hai. Passive trader apna bhaav likh kar intezaar karta hai (limit order): behtar bhaav, par sauda hoga ya nahi, guarantee nahi.
